name: crystal_barricade_prevents_only_noncombat_damage_to_your_others
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Prevent all noncombat damage that would be dealt to other creatures you control.' Seat 0 controls the Barricade (0/4) and a 2/2 Bear; seat 1 an Ogre (3/3) and a 2/2 Bear. Noncombat damage (another effect's, from the Ogre): 2 to seat 0's Bear is prevented (no mark); 2 to the Barricade itself is dealt (it is not another creature); 1 to seat 1's Bear is dealt (not seat 0's). Then seat 0's Bear attacks and the Ogre blocks: combat damage is not prevented, the Bear dies and deals 2 to the Ogre.
